evidence.claim: Crane took its name from the creek when the town was platted in 1895.
evidence.quote: Crane was platted in 1895, taking its name from nearby Crane Creek.

evidence.claim: The stream runs through town and belongs to the James River system, part of the larger White River drainage.
evidence.quote: Crane Creek is a 23.2-mile-long (37.3 km) stream that flows through the town of Crane.  The creek, a tributary of the James River and part of the White River drainage basin
